paite: Chiamtehna sagihna aphel lai in dakkal kimkhat sung van adai sipsip hi.
heading: Chiamtehna Sagihna
english: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

paite: Huchi in Pathian ma a angel sagih dinghte ka mu a, amaute kiang ah pengkul sagih piak in a-om hi.
english: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

paite: Huan angel dang khat ahong pai a, gimnamtui halna dangka-eng bel tawi in, maitam kiang ah adingh hi, akiang ah gimnamtui tampi laltutphah ma a om dangka-eng maitam teng a misiangthou tengteng thumna toh hel ding in, piak in a-om hi.
english: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.

paite: Huai gimnamtui khu leh misiangthoute thumna angel khut a kipan Pathian ma ah azamtou hi.
english: The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.

paite: Angel in gimnamtui halna dangka-eng bel ala a; huai maitam amei in ahihdim a, leitung ah apaikhia a; huan awgingte, van-gingte leh khophiate leh zinlingte ahong om hi.
english: The angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, then threw it on the earth. Thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake followed.

paite: Huan angel sagih pengkul sagih tawite mut ding in ahong kisa uhi.
heading: Pengkulte
english: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

paite: Angel masapen in amut a, sisan toh kihel gial leh mei ahong om hi, huaite leitung a paihkhiak in a-om ua; leitung mun thum a khen mun khat akangbei hi, huan sing mun thum a khen mun khat akangbei a; loupa hing tengteng akangbei hi.
english: The first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burned up, and one third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.

paite: Huan angel nihna in amut a, tang lianpi mei a kang bang a kang hileh kilawm tuipi ah paihkhiak in ahong om a; tuipi mun thum a khen mun khat sisan asuak hi.
english: The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,

paite: Huai tuipi a thil hingte hinna neite mun thum a khen mun khat asi ua; long mun thum a khen mun khat hihsiat in a-om hi.
english: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.

paite: Huan angel thumna in amut a, van a kipan in aksi lianpi, meisel bang a kuang ahong kesuk a, lui mun thum a khen mun khat leh tui tuikhukte tung adeng hi.
english: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of water.

paite: Huai aksi min Gamsai ahi; tui mun thum a khen mun khat gamsai asuak hi; tuite hihkhaat a a-om ziak un mi tampi asi uhi.
english: The name of the star is “Wormwood.” One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters, because they were made bitter.

paite: Huan angel lina in amut a, huan ni mun thum a khen mun khat leh kha mun thum a khen mun khat leh aksi mun thum a khen mun khat hihsiat ahong hi a; huchi in avaknate uh mun thum a khen mun khat hihmial in a-om a; sun hun seh thum suah seh khat leh zan hun seh thum suah seh khat beisak in a-om hi.
english: The fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars, so that one third of them would be darkened; and the day wouldn’t shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.

paite: Huan ka etleh, angel khat van laizawl a leng in aw ngaihtak in, "Tunggik, tunggik, angel thum pengkul mut lai dingte leh huai ging hong om lai dingte ziak in leitung a omte tung agik," achih ka za hi.
english: I saw, and I heard an eagle, flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the other blasts of the trumpets of the three angels, who are yet to sound!”
